name: Brent Crude Rips: FX Forward Returns by DXY Regime
description: Event study analyzing FX forward returns (USDCAD, EURUSD, AUDUSD) after Brent crude oil surges 30%+ over a rolling 63-day window, split by DXY regime. Uses DTWEXBGS (Fed Broad Dollar Index) 60-day return to classify each event as DXY Uptrend (>0) or Downtrend (<=0). Separate summary tables and bar charts for each regime show event count, avg forward returns at +5d/+10d/+20d, and hit rates.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE RIPS: FX FORWARD RETURNS BY DXY REGIME
# =============================================================================
# Event: Brent crude rolling 63-day return crosses above +30%
# DXY Regime: 60-day ROC on DTWEXBGS (Fed Broad Dollar Index)
#   - Uptrend: DXY 60d return > 0
#   - Downtrend: DXY 60d return <= 0
# Forward returns measured on USDCAD, EURUSD, AUDUSD at +5d, +10d, +20d
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c

# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE DATA (SC Futures — Crude Oil Brent)
# =============================================================================

brent_raw = reference_futures(ticker="SC")()
brent_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(brent_raw.o, brent_raw.h, brent_raw.l, brent_raw.c, brent_raw.v, brent_raw.oi, brent_raw.s)
brent_close = ffill(brent_cont.c)

# =============================================================================
# DXY DATA (DTWEXBGS — Fed Broad Dollar Index)
# =============================================================================

dxy_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DTWEXBGS", use_alfred=False)()
dxy_val = ffill(dxy_raw.result)
dxy_60d_ret = roc(period=60)(dxy_val)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING 63-DAY RETURN ON BRENT
# =============================================================================

brent_63d_ret = roc(period=63)(brent_close)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT DETECTION: First bar where 63-day return crosses above 30%
# =============================================================================

is_brent_rip = crossover(brent_63d_ret, 0.30)

# =============================================================================
# DXY REGIME CLASSIFICATION AT EVENT
# =============================================================================

dxy_uptrend = dxy_60d_ret > 0
dxy_downtrend = dxy_60d_ret <= 0

is_rip_up = is_brent_rip and dxy_uptrend
is_rip_dn = is_brent_rip and dxy_downtrend

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS ON FX PAIRS (+5d, +10d, +20d)
# =============================================================================

post_5d = ((close_fx << 5) - close_fx) / close_fx
post_10d = ((close_fx << 10) - close_fx) / close_fx
post_20d = ((close_fx << 20) - close_fx) / close_fx

# =============================================================================
# EVENT-FILTERED RETURNS: DXY UPTREND REGIME
# =============================================================================

rip_post5_up = where(is_rip_up, post_5d)
rip_post10_up = where(is_rip_up, post_10d)
rip_post20_up = where(is_rip_up, post_20d)

hit_5d_up = where(is_rip_up, 1.0 if post_5d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_10d_up = where(is_rip_up, 1.0 if post_10d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_20d_up = where(is_rip_up, 1.0 if post_20d > 0 else 0.0)

rip_count_up = where(is_rip_up, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT-FILTERED RETURNS: DXY DOWNTREND REGIME
# =============================================================================

rip_post5_dn = where(is_rip_dn, post_5d)
rip_post10_dn = where(is_rip_dn, post_10d)
rip_post20_dn = where(is_rip_dn, post_20d)

hit_5d_dn = where(is_rip_dn, 1.0 if post_5d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_10d_dn = where(is_rip_dn, 1.0 if post_10d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_20d_dn = where(is_rip_dn, 1.0 if post_20d > 0 else 0.0)

rip_count_dn = where(is_rip_dn, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKER DATA
# =============================================================================

ev_brent_ret = where(is_brent_rip, brent_63d_ret)
ev_dxy_ret = where(is_brent_rip, dxy_60d_ret)
ev_regime = where(is_brent_rip, conditional_select(dxy_uptrend, 1.0, 0.0))
ev_post5 = where(is_brent_rip, post_5d)
ev_post10 = where(is_brent_rip, post_10d)
ev_post20 = where(is_brent_rip, post_20d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Summary Table — DXY Uptrend Regime
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='Brent Rip FX Returns: DXY Uptrend Regime',
    category='DXY Uptrend',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='FX Forward Returns (DXY Uptrend)',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Events', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +5d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +10d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +20d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit +5d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit +10d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit +20d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(rip_count_up, rip_post5_up, rip_post10_up, rip_post20_up, hit_5d_up, hit_10d_up, hit_20d_up)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Summary Table — DXY Downtrend Regime
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='Brent Rip FX Returns: DXY Downtrend Regime',
    category='DXY Downtrend',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='FX Forward Returns (DXY Downtrend)',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Events', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +5d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +10d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +20d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit +5d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit +10d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit +20d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=1
)(rip_count_dn, rip_post5_dn, rip_post10_dn, rip_post20_dn, hit_5d_dn, hit_10d_dn, hit_20d_dn)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Bar Chart — DXY Uptrend Regime
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Avg FX Returns After Brent Rip: DXY Uptrend',
    category='DXY Uptrend',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['+5d', '+10d', '+20d'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(rip_post5_up, rip_post10_up, rip_post20_up)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Bar Chart — DXY Downtrend Regime
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Avg FX Returns After Brent Rip: DXY Downtrend',
    category='DXY Downtrend',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['+5d', '+10d', '+20d'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(rip_post5_dn, rip_post10_dn, rip_post20_dn)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Brent Rip with DXY Regime Detail
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Brent Crude Rip (+30% in 63d)',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Brent 63d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='DXY 60d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='DXY Regime (1=Up)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX +5d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX +10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX +20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_brent_rip, ev_brent_ret, ev_dxy_ret, ev_regime, ev_post5, ev_post10, ev_post20)
